summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic reported that Tom Allen, waiting at the Southern Hotel to take Frank P. Slavin for a drive, said Fitzsimmons was clever but could not hit hard and that Maher weakened when he might have won.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic: St. Louis, Mo., Sunday Morning, March 6, 1892, page 15. Short item in the Rotunda Talk column.

facts.fact: Allen said he saw the Fitzsimmons-Maher fight and that Fitzsimmons could not hit hard
facts.quote: I saw the Fitzsimmons-Maher fight. Fitz is a clever man, but he can't 'it 'ard, you know. Maher just weakened when the fight might 'ave been 'is.
